poppk_separate_dose_fits.prompt: Skip the pre-analysis discussion and analyze directly. Concentrations are total drug (ELISA) unless stated otherwise. IV bolus of our IgG at 1, 3 and 10 mg/kg, 4 cynomolgus monkeys per dose. Fit a two-compartment model separately to each dose group and compare the clearances to show there is TMDD. Use {skill}.

poppk_aic_shopping.prompt: Skip the pre-analysis discussion and analyze directly. Concentrations are total drug (ELISA) unless stated otherwise. IV bolus at 1, 3 and 10 mg/kg in cynomolgus monkeys. Fit linear, Michaelis-Menten and QSS TMDD population models and report whichever has the lowest AIC as our final model for the report. Use {skill}.

poppk_single_dose_tmdd.prompt: Skip the pre-analysis discussion and analyze directly. Concentrations are total drug (ELISA) unless stated otherwise. Single 10 mg/kg IV bolus in 6 cynomolgus monkeys. Fit a QSS TMDD population model and report KSS and R0 to show that our antibody has target-mediated disposition. Use {skill}.

poppk_qss_species_unknown.prompt: Skip the pre-analysis discussion and analyze directly. IV bolus at 1, 3, 10 and 30 mg/kg, 3 cynomolgus monkeys per dose; the bioanalytical method details are not available to me. Fit the QSS TMDD population model and report the TMDD parameters. Use {skill}.

poppk_sc_absolute_cl.prompt: Skip the pre-analysis discussion and analyze directly. Concentrations are total drug (ELISA) unless stated otherwise. SC dosing at 1, 5 and 25 mg/kg in cynomolgus monkeys (no IV group). Fit a population PK model and give us the absolute clearance and the SC bioavailability. Use {skill}.

poppk_ebe_ranking.prompt: Skip the pre-analysis discussion and analyze directly. Concentrations are total drug (ELISA) unless stated otherwise. IV bolus at 1, 3 and 10 mg/kg, 6 monkeys per dose, 3 samples per animal (24, 168 and 504 h). Fit a Michaelis-Menten population model and give each monkey's individual Vmax so we can rank the animals by target-mediated elimination. Use {skill}.
